scripts.sate:build: cd android && rm -rf app/build/generated/assets app/build/intermediates/assets && SATE_VARIANT=sate ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
scripts.sate:android: npm run sate:prebuild && npm run sate:build && adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
scripts.companion:android: npm run companion:prebuild && npm run companion:build && adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
